usage: “搭車” is used when talking about taking any form of transport, such as bus, train, or taxi.
It can be used in present tense to describe a current action, e.g. 我而家搭車 (I am taking transport now).
It can also be used to describe a habitual action, like 每日搭車返工 (take transport to work every day).
You can add specific transport details after 搭車, for example 搭的士 (take a taxi) or 搭巴士 (take a bus).
It frequently appears in casual conversations about daily commuting or travel.
